description: Launch X on the character's phone
goal: Day 5 of the phone; Instagram and TikTok are already warming

description: Display name — nothing suggestive: name, bio, avatar and banner all show outside the sensitive-media setting (personas.md §6)
X offers a phone number first; the signup is by email everywhere [to verify]
The character's own Gmail, created at J0

prompt: Set the birthday {birthday} on the wheel. It must be 18+ or X never offers the sensitive-media settings this account needs. Tap Next, then resume.
Read the code for {email} in the Gmail notification (GET /api/phone/notifications/<serial>) and type it on the device (POST /api/phone/type). Do not open Gmail. Then resume.

Type the X password for {handle} on the device. Read it from the Keychain (ofmai-social-x-<slug>) and type it with POST /api/phone/type; it is never a parameter of this run (R9). We enable no 2FA of our own: the session lives on one phone that never logs out. If X forces 2FA, choose email — that is another `email` checkpoint. Then resume.
If the username is taken, clear it and type fallback handle 2, then 3, from the persona sheet — and update the sheet. Then resume.
'Authenticate your account': solve the puzzle by hand — never by an agent, never by a solving service (R25). Three failures in a row end the day. Then resume.

Account suggestions: skip them. X sometimes refuses to move on without one follow. If it does, stop here and abort the run rather than follow: no follow exists at creation (R16), and an account whose first action is a forced follow starts in the wrong place. Otherwise resume.
description: Follow suggestions — the one screen where abort is the right answer

prompt: 18+ settings, BEFORE the first post. Settings and privacy > Privacy and safety > Content you see > 'Display media that may contain sensitive content' ON. Then Your posts > 'Mark media you post as having material that may be sensitive' ON. [labels to verify] Both, or the account's own posts get hidden from it and from everyone. Then resume.

Profile picture: pick the MOST RECENT gallery item — the watermarked variant pushed with adb push minutes ago. Nothing suggestive in the avatar or the banner: both show outside the sensitive-media setting. Confirm, come back to the editor, then resume.

description: X bio of the persona sheet — ASCII, '18+' whether the character is declared or not (R2), no link before the first post (R22)

prompt: Last look: the profile shows {handle}, the bio and the picture, no link, and both sensitive-media settings are on. Register it on the Mac mini the same day — accounts add x @{handle} --device <serial> --tz <persona tz> --created-on <today> — then resume to close the run. The reddit-style script app and the OAuth tokens come later, never today.
description: The run ends on the profile screen showing {handle}
